csharp_new_line_before_open_brace #

Which constructs put '{' on a new line. Microsoft documents all, none, or one or more of twelve code elements separated by commas. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-30 against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6, one value per run, on a probe whose every body holds two statements and every initializer six elements so that no place_simple_* rule could join a construct and hide the brace: the C# formatter answers to SEVEN of the twelve, and the other five are covered by a neighbour and move nothing on their own. types also takes a block NAMESPACE; methods also takes LOCAL FUNCTIONS; properties takes the accessor LIST of a property, an indexer and an event alike; accessors takes the accessor BODY; lambdas also takes an anonymous method's delegate(…) { }; object_collection_array_initializers also takes a SWITCH EXPRESSION's and a PROPERTY PATTERN's braces. Inert: anonymous_methods, anonymous_types, events, indexers, local_functions. all is exactly the union of the seven, confirmed rather than assumed. ⚠ Skala read this flags option as a two-valued switch — every value but none behaved as all, and 2 of its 15 values agreed with the oracle; now 15 of 15. ⚠ The SPLIT direction is not implemented: brace placement here is a join decision, so a K&R input under a non-none value comes back K&R where the oracle splits. Invisible to this row, whose fixture is written Allman. SK-DIV-0091.

Typeany combination, comma-separated, of all, none, accessors, anonymous_methods, anonymous_types, control_blocks, events, indexers, lambdas, local_functions, methods, object_collection_array_initializers, properties, types
